_comment: Whole setups for activities whose strategy page has no loadout yet. Appended by generator/curated.py as if extraction had found them on sourcePage, so every name still resolves through the wiki's Module:Loadout. A stopgap, not a second source: once the wiki publishes a setup for the activity, validation fails the build and the entry should be deleted. A name that stops resolving fails it too. prepots are potions drunk before the fight, banked beside the layout (at most four).

curated.reason: Curated from launch-day play on 20 October 2026, because the wiki had no loadout for the raid yet. Min/maxed: the best overall item is worn for the whole raid (Twisted bow in Masori), and a switch earns an inventory slot only for a boss it is needed on. Crush is the weakest defence on nearly every boss, so a four-item melee swap (Scythe of vitur, the Inquisitor's hauberk and plateskirt, Amulet of rancour) covers the downed Guardian, Bork, Xarth's second phase and Ocellus's final quadrant, which requires melee. The Twinflame staff with a Tome of fire makes two utility casts: water on Xarth's corpses, air on Ezekiel's swords and earth on the Guardian battery. Those targets have Magic levels of 50-100, so the casts land from Masori without a mage switch. Tonalztics of Ralos is the spec, because Ocellus keeps defence reductions across phases. Sanfew serums cover Dreadnoth's venom tiles, and every other freed slot goes to supplies. Dropped as too small an upgrade for a slot: the mage armour switch (the casts are utility only), the Zaryte crossbow, Twisted buckler and ruby bolts (the Twisted bow out-damages them over a fight, and Ralos covers the spec), and the Infernal cape (+8 melee strength over Dizana's quiver, for a whole slot).
